answers.answer: Set A: LE 200, Set B: LE 200
solution: Mean = total of values / their number.

question.text: Compare the wages of the two sets A and B. What do you deduce?

answers.answer: The two sets have the same mean (LE 200), median and mode (LE 180), but set B is more dispersed (range 350) than set A (range 70).
solution: The means are equal: 200 for both sets.
The range of B is larger, so B's wages differ more.
So B is more dispersed; A is more homogeneous.

checks.resolve_answer: Both sets have the same mean (LE 200), median and mode (LE 180), but the range of A is $240-170=70$ while the range of B is $400-50=350$. So set B is more dispersed (less homogeneous) than set A; the mean alone doesn't show the difference.
